title: LockerKeyBackup
description: locker.key-backup@1: the person's private keys, wrapped. The wrapping key comes from the locker passphrase with PBKDF2-SHA-256, so the server stores bytes it cannot open; a passkey (WebAuthn PRF) may wrap the same bytes later without changing this shape.

method.description: How the private keys are wrapped. A passkey-only locker comes later.

nonce.description: Twelve random bytes, base64: the AES-GCM nonce of the wrapped keys.

wrapped_keys.description: The two private keys as JWKs, sealed with AES-256-GCM under the derived key, base64.
